name: skill-composition
instructions:
Compose skills into chains and workflows with explicit contracts: declare the producer-consumer edges between skills, verify artifact compatibility at each edge, and keep the chain inside a declared budget.

Capabilities:
- declare a skill chain as producer-consumer edges
- verify artifact compatibility at each edge before execution
- run a chain inside a declared iteration and cost budget
- report per-edge handoff evidence for the chain

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/foundation/skill-composition/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Every edge in the chain passed its artifact compatibility check and the chain stayed inside its declared budget.
